summary: Iteration 2 focused on the five new feature blocks (comments, chat, friendships, share link + friends-only visibility, and Super Admin). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_lopi_v2_features.py with 16 new pytest cases — ALL 16 PASS (16/16) plus the 19 iteration-1 tests still PASS (35/35 overall). Frontend: ran Playwright mobile-viewport (390x844) smoke covering: login (carolinav), home header notifications bell + friends icon, /notifications route + back, ParcheCard→detail, comment create+delete with own-only trash icon, join→'Abrir chat del parche' → chat send/receive, /friends 4 tabs + search returning Agregar buttons, non-admin visit to /admin shows 'Solo Super Admin' fallback, logout, login as super admin (gerencia@urielhernandez.com), /profile showing shield icon, /admin with 4 tabs, Stats rendering real DB values (16 users / 20 parches / 100% with participants / users_by_city etc.), Users tab searching 'carolinav' filtering to her row with Activar/Suspender/Bloquear buttons, Parches tab hide/delete toggles present, Reports tab all filter chips present. Cleaned all TEST_ data + comments/messages + notifications + friendships at the end so DB is back to seeded state (16 users incl. super admin, 20 parches, 0 comments/msgs).

issues: React Native Web deprecation warnings persist in console: 'textShadow*'/'shadow*' style props deprecated, and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated. Cosmetic only (already flagged in iteration_1).

The `q` search state is shared across Users/Parches tabs. When you type 'carolinav' in Users search and then switch to Parches, the search stays 'carolinav' and Parches shows 'Sin parches'. Minor UX polish — either reset q on tab change or use separate state per tab. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) On /admin, reset the search `q` state (or the status/hidden filters) when switching between Estadísticas/Usuarios/Parches/Reportes tabs so state from one tab doesn't leak into another.
(Optional) Address the React Native Web `textShadow*/shadow*/props.pointerEvents` deprecation warnings (already noted in iteration 1).

(Optional, from problem statement) Deep-link redirect after login/register was implemented in /_layout.tsx (pendingRoute) and looks correct on code review, but was not exercised end-to-end via web preview per the note in the request. Consider a manual test on native Expo Go.
No blocking action items — all requested features are implemented and working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `_ensure_super_admin()` on startup + auto-promotion on both /register and /login make super_admin idempotent and race-safe. Verified via 3 promotion tests.
Friends-only visibility is enforced in TWO places: the feed filter loop AND the _can_view_parche detail check. Both cover creator, participants, and _friends_of(). This is defensive and correct.

admin_delete_parche cascades to db.comments AND db.messages by parche_id — verified via TestSuperAdmin.test_parches_admin_hide_delete_and_cascade. Consider also deleting orphan notifications with `data.parche_id == pid` for total cleanliness, but current behavior is acceptable.

`require_active` correctly blocks PATCH /auth/profile for suspended users while `current_user` allows GET-only for them and blocks blocked users at the token level. `admin_set_user_status` refuses to change SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL. All three protections verified.
server.py at 1227 lines — still within the 700-line guideline but growing; consider splitting `/admin/*`, `/friends/*`, `/parches/*/comments|messages` into separate routers if more features land.

Frontend Playwright note (test tooling, not app bug): the comment-send-btn Pressable receives clicks correctly when using DOM click(), but Playwright's `page.click(force=True)` sometimes hits the inner Text node without triggering the React Native Web Pressable's onPress. This is a known RN Web + Playwright quirk. In real mobile usage taps work fine — confirmed the same button works for a plain `.click()` and the backend POST fires (201).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, notifications route, parche detail, comment create/delete via UI, chat send, friends 4 tabs + search, non-admin /admin fallback, super-admin login, super-admin /admin 4 tabs + real stats + users search + parches actions + reports filters)
